title: Partial Application
description:
Implement a `partial` function that pre-fills some arguments of a function and returns a new function expecting the remaining arguments.

**Example:**
```js
const add = (a, b) => a + b;
const add5 = partial(add, 5);
add5(3)  // 8
add5(10) // 15
```
ai_context: Learners often hardcode the number of pre-set arguments instead of using rest/spread, limiting the function to a fixed arity. The elegant solution captures `presetArgs` in a closure and spreads them before the later arguments using the rest/spread operators.
